description: This file contains utility functions and classes for manipulating and comparing computational graphs in the PyTorch FX framework, including a holder module class, a function to lift a subgraph as a module, and a graph comparison function.

classes.name: HolderModule
classes.description: A module that copies all attributes from an original module to submodules, used for creating modules that mirror attribute structure.

methods.name: tuple[GraphModule,dict[str,str]] lift_subgraph_as_module( gm: GraphModule, subgraph: Graph, comp_name: str = "", class_name: str = "GraphModule", )
methods.description: Creates a GraphModule object from a given subgraph, copying attributes from the parent GraphModule and returning the new module along with a mapping of original to new attribute paths.

methods.name: bool compare_graphs(left: Graph, right: Graph)
methods.description: Compares two graphs for structural identity, including nodes, connectivity, and order of inputs/outputs, returning True if they are identical.

ctags.name: lift_subgraph_as_module
ctags.signature: ( gm: GraphModule, subgraph: Graph, comp_name: str = "", class_name: str = "GraphModule", )
